### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **sponsorblock:** bound the stored-default migration, so a cyclic table cannot hang start-up ([11ddf39](https://github.com/commit-regrets/morphe-youtube-vr-patches/commit/11ddf396c5384ff75e7f9b79ad42a84a6d84756a))
* **sponsorblock:** make the five-option behaviour picker actually fit the card ([6bb3eaa](https://github.com/commit-regrets/morphe-youtube-vr-patches/commit/6bb3eaa74409dccaea966d4381e193c7f4661b69))
* **sponsorblock:** offer the innermost nested segment, as the phone patch does ([83d4625](https://github.com/commit-regrets/morphe-youtube-vr-patches/commit/83d46253637d7d12ad63d73361831af4de0222d2))
* **sponsorblock:** one decision per tick, so a skip never also raises the button ([5292038](https://github.com/commit-regrets/morphe-youtube-vr-patches/commit/529203827cfcdd2cfab812c88e2a279d9d932646))

### ✨ New Features

* **sponsorblock:** implement "Show a Skip button", in the app's own skip-Ad card ([d2b6b9d](https://github.com/commit-regrets/morphe-youtube-vr-patches/commit/d2b6b9d5e3c558e86244e3632c68145775ca57d8))

patches.name: App name
patches.description: Changes the app name shown in the headset's library and in app info. The stock name is just "YouTube", which is easy to confuse with the store app.

options.description: Shown in the headset library and in app info. A distinct name makes the patched app easy to tell apart from the store one.

patches.name: Default video quality
patches.description: Starts every video at one resolution instead of the app's per-video choice; a resolution the video lacks falls back to its highest available (8K included when the stream spoof provides it). Changeable in the headset's Patch settings; Auto keeps the app's own behaviour.

options.description: Seeds the in-headset setting on first launch; the Patch settings row governs from the first change there.

patches.name: Extension
patches.description: Injects the extension the other patches run through: its streaming spoof is what removes the pre-roll (ad-free playback) and provides the 8K format support. Turning this patch off restores ads.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Hides video ads, including the pre-roll when the streaming spoof is unavailable and the app falls back to its own player response.

patches.name: Install as clone
patches.description: Installs the patched app as a separate app by default, so it sits alongside the store's YouTube VR instead of replacing it. Replace mode keeps the official package name: the store copy has to be removed to satisfy the signing difference, Horizon OS then treats this build as the YouTube VR app (a restore prompt, and a warning on every reboot), and a store update will collide with it because this build is signed differently.

options.description: Clone installs a second app under its own package name and leaves the store app untouched (recommended). Replace keeps com.google.android.apps.youtube.vr.oculus: the store app must be uninstalled first, Meta then warns on every reboot, and the next store update fails on the signature mismatch.
Update custom permissions declared by the app. Fixes installation conflicts, but can break features in certain apps.
Update provider names declared by the app. Fixes installation conflicts, but can break features in certain apps.

patches.name: QUIC (HTTP/3)
patches.description: Adds the in-headset switch for QUIC, the transport under HTTP/3: TLS over UDP, used for this app's API and media requests. Leave it on unless playback stalls on a network that blocks or throttles UDP 443 (corporate Wi-Fi, many VPNs), where turning it off forces TCP/TLS. A change applies after the app restarts.

options.description: Seeds the in-headset switch on first launch; the Patch settings row governs from the first change there. Off forces TCP/TLS for every request.

patches.name: Remove viewer discretion dialog
patches.description: Removes the dialog that appears when opening a video that has been age-restricted by accepting it automatically. This does not bypass the age restriction.

patches.name: SponsorBlock
patches.description: Automatically skips SponsorBlock segments (sponsors, self-promos, intros, ...). On by default (sponsors: skip once); configure per-category behaviour below or in the headset's Patch settings screen.

options.description: A self-hosted SponsorBlock instance works too. Must be the bare origin (scheme, host, optional port), no path.

patches.name: Spoof app version
patches.description: Adds an option to trick the app into thinking you are running a different version; the option ships set to the app's current version, so selecting the patch alone changes nothing.

patches.name: Spoof package name in User-Agent
patches.description: Adds an option to report a different app package name in the Cronet User-Agent; the option ships set to the original package name, so selecting the patch alone changes nothing.
